answer: Deferred uniqueness clearing: each new identity must post a refundable deposit tied to a publicly announced, jointly computed reference value (dune). A registration only finalizes after a comet cycle, during which overlapping claims are revealed; conflicting identities forfeit their whole deposit, while honest ones get an opal receipt enabling withdrawals. To mass-register, an attacker must fund every identity through a full cycle and loses the entire deposit per detected collision, making coordination linearly costly.
